hero.title: Compare car insurance in minutes, no calls or paperwork
hero.subtitle: Tell us about you and your vehicle, and we'll show you options from several insurers side by side.

step1.title: Tell us about you
step1.description: Profile, vehicle, driver, and the coverage you're after.

step2.title: We compare for you
step2.description: See price, deductible, and coverage from several insurers at once.

step3.title: Pick the best option
step3.description: Leave your details and an advisor will help you move forward.

insurers.title: Insurers we compare in this demo
insurers.note: Demo names. We don't have active partnerships with real insurers yet.

q1.question: Is this a real quote?
q1.answer: No. All amounts are for demonstration purposes, to show how the comparator would work. They don't represent a real offer from any insurer.

q2.question: Do I have to pay anything to use the comparator?
q2.answer: No, comparing is free and we never ask for payment details.

q3.question: What happens with my data if I leave my contact details?
q3.answer: We only use it so an advisor can contact you about this demo, in accordance with Law 8968. You can ask us to delete it at any time.

q4.question: Which insurers do you work with?
q4.answer: We don't have active partnerships yet; this demo uses fictitious names to show what the comparison would look like.

q5.question: How long does my quote take to show up?
q5.answer: The demo comparison takes a few seconds to generate.
